run_adsorption_relaxation: run AdsorptionRunner to relax adsorbate plus surface configurations and compute adsorption energy
calculate_adsorption_energy: calculate adsorption energy by relaxing atomic structures using an ASE calculator and LBFGS optimizer
write_adsorption_results: write adsorption calculation results to a compressed JSON file in the specified results directory
configure_adsorption_runner: configure AdsorptionRunner with custom fmax convergence threshold, max relaxation steps, and surface relaxation option
chunk_adsorption_jobs: split adsorption relaxation calculations across multiple array jobs using job_num and num_jobs parameters
